input.incomplete_policy: zero input clusters and fade every active slot to zero

matching.selection: nearest unmatched active slot with deterministic slot-index tie break
matching.nearby_rule: same slot ramps delay, amplitude and direction
matching.topology_rule: unmatched new cluster fades in while unmatched old slot fades out
matching.retirement_rule: a slot is retired after its zero-gain ramp completes

output.direction_rule: normalize; degenerate direction falls back to +Z
output.audio_rule: control DTO only; no delay line, PCM, OpenAL or renderer mutation
